messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] summary function does not work in mqmscan
parts:
The output of mqmscan() with multiple phenotype columns is a list of mqmscan-type results.
So summary() doesn't work with it immediately as given.

You could try

lapply(result, summary)

to get the summaries of the scans of the individual phenotypes.

karl
